programmes.d: While on a secret mission to Afghanistan, President Kirkman meets with two infamous warlords.
Emily, Seth, Aaron, Llyor and Kendra join forces to get answers and possibly save a life.
Kirkman is alerted to a group who refuse to evacuate when a forest fire threatens to engulf their cabin.
It’s been ten weeks since his wife died, and President Kirkman’s senior staff insist he seek professional help
A missile meant to bring water to astronauts in space is hacked. Kirkman must work with Russia to save lives.
When a video of the president visiting prison leaks to the media, his team works to minimize the fallout.
When a blackout threatens to shut down the government, President Kirkman joins forces with the D.C. mayor.
As tensions between East and West Hanchu escalate, Kirkman travels to Camp David to broker a peace treaty.
President Kirkman and his staff have credible intelligence that a dirty bomb is on U.S. soil.
Following the deadly bomb explosion inside a D.C. metro station, President Kirkman declares war on Kunami.
More content from President Kirkman’s confidential therapy sessions leaks out.
Attorney Ethan West calls on President Kirkman’s closest advisors and staff as he begins his investigation
President Kirkman negotiates with a foreign government to release an American held overseas.
White House Council Kendra Daynes finds herself in danger, putting another White House staffer’s life at risk.
A natural disaster threatens the lives of two staffers. The president makes an announcement no one saw coming.
Now running for office for the first time, Kirkman and his nascent campaign stumble out of the gate.
A heated debate over child marriage roils Kirkman's staff; Opioid addiction hits home for Mars.
A political attack on Kirkman puts transgender rights in the spotlight; Aaron weighs a major decision.
Aaron's heritage and a widespread teachers' strike become polarizing issues.
Emotions run high after a despicable news story goes viral. Wells finds a clue pointing to conspiracy.
A dying Guatemalan child in a Texas hospital brings immigration to the fore.
A stray Russian bomber jeopardizes Seattle, Mars crusades against a drug company.
Kirkman mobilizes a frantic hunt for the bioterrorist.
Trailing in the polls, Kirkman weighs forcing the FBI's hand over the bioterrorism plot.
On Election Day, Kirkman turns to his therapist to assuage his conscience about the momentous prior 36 hours.
Tom Kirkman is a lower-level cabinet member who is suddenly appointed President of the United States.
Hours after the attack, President Kirkman steps into his role as Commander-in-Chief in the midst of chaos.
President Kirkman and his staff work to keep a high-level security breach of the White House a secret.
Kirkman learns who is behind the attack and grapples with the prospect of war and brewing domestic troubles.
